body:
Several years ago, around 2019, I decided to replicate a recipe for "flying ointment"- the substance witches allegedly used to create to induce trance-like states. There is much debate on the historical accuracy of these claims, however, since most mentions of the ointment were written during the 16th century, a time riddled with religious paranoia, witch trials, and false accusations in many areas of the globe. Nonetheless, the idea intrigued me enough to try and make my own, with some artistic liberties.
Entheogens and herbs used in shamanic or spiritual rituals throughout history and cultures deeply fascinate me. I am especially drawn to those that induce dream effects or facilitate dream recall and lucidity. I concocted my salve with the intention of learning its effects on dreams and sleep, using ingredients which include belladonna, mandrake, and datura (a moderate dosage of each, although I forget the exact amounts), slow cooked in a carrier oil to create a concentrated salve. I will say, if I were to make this again, I would ensure proper ventilation as the fumes made me scared I was going to kill everyone in my apartment complex, or at least make them deliriously high for a few days. I was too scared to use it for years, given the amount of negative experiences Ive read when it comes to nightshades and baneful herbs.
About two years ago, my interest resparked and I finally decided to try it, using a very small amount on my pulse points and underarms before bed. I didnt notice any effects the first night, so over the course of the next couple of weeks I tried it a few more times, steadily increasing my dosage.
I didnt notice any effects the first night, so over the course of the next couple of weeks I tried it a few more times, steadily increasing my dosage.
After the third night I noticed a considerable difference in my dreamstate. I was having much more vivid dreams, often about bizarre subject matter, and was able to recall them much more easily than usual.
I have used this salve many times since that first experience, and have noticed a distinct pattern. Whenever I use the salve, my dreams are often very disturbing, visceral, and gory, and often about things I have deep-seated anxieties about. For example, an overarching theme is my pets (whom I love dearly) dying or getting sick in very gruesome ways. Ive also dreamt about friends turning into demons (often featuring friendships I have some level of preexisting anxiety or distrust around) and bizarre entities, often cannibalistic or murderous. During these experiences, however, I feel incredibly calm and unshaken by the horrifying things going on around me. I simply respond to them neutrally and dont feel like anything is wrong.
This experimentation is certainly not for the faint of heart, but I do see tremendous value in the ability to face my anxieties and scary situations without actually feeling the fear or anxiety that would otherwise coincide. As for the following morning, I usually do not feel any sort of hangover, and havent noticed a huge difference in how I feel besides being a little drowsy but slightly more mentally alert.
